name: expense-api

dependencies.name: expense-db
dependencies.description: Stores employees, claims, expense lines, receipts, categories and export batches.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Sign-in client shared with the web app; the gateway verifies tokens against it.

description: The single backend for claims, approvals, people and payroll exports. It owns all business data in its Postgres database: claims with expense lines and receipts (F1), the manager's team queue and decisions (F2), and CSV export batches that mark claims exported in one transaction (F3). It also lets Finance set each employee's line manager. Separate from the web app because the browser must not hold data or credentials. It does not render UI, issue tokens, or integrate with any payroll system.
